purpose: Validate the independent SIGAR district-control snapshot without treating a short staged horizon as a control failure.
promotion_requirements: all three strength trajectories reach target_day
control snapshot is scored with the frozen measurement rule
held-out competitor comparison is retained unchanged
latent and recorded violence are reported separately
no parameter or observation-model changes are made after inspecting target results

success_gate.reason: No harmonized pre-target longitudinal control panel exists yet. A numeric success threshold must be derived and preregistered from training-only information before any future target-period run can be classified as passed or failed under the new observation operator.

current_staged_status.reason: The one-year staged run ends before the 2017-10-15 control snapshot and cannot license a control claim.

runtime_planning.note: Estimate only; do not interpret as measured target-run runtime.

execution_rule: Run once from the frozen transfer tree; retain every completed strength atomically; never tune on this target gate.
